placements.title: A rollback only counts once it has been rehearsed
placements.frame: What does this expression say makes a rollback or recovery path something the organization actually has, and how is that practice scheduled and owned?
placements.why: The graph has no existing leaves. The position holds a directive for monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals, the maxim that an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback, and the memo's cadence and owner lines. The shared subject is release safety through rehearsed rollback, which future envelopes on drills, recovery and release safety can keep feeding. It is a theme, not a one-off fact.
